messages:
Emma Chen: Quick weekly health check — CoralEdge private/VPC deployment. Region snapshot below. Drop short notes on any regressions or ongoing tickets. cc @Sofia @Raj

Raj Patel: us-east-1: 99.98% uptime this week, p95 latency 95ms (vs 88ms last week), error rate 0.6% (gateway 0.2%, runtime 0.4%). Spend trending +12% — increased embedding jobs from staging.

Sofia Martinez: eu-west-1: 99.92% uptime, p95 latency 130ms, error rate 1.1% mostly KMS timeouts during key rotation window on Thu 03:14 UTC. KMS ticket IN-2145 opened. Temporary workaround: pinned to older key version.

Liam O'Connor: ap-southeast-2: 99.65% uptime, p95 220ms (high due to occasional node OOM + redis reconnects), error rate 1.8%. I've rescheduled batch jobs to off-peak and bumped redis in the pool.

Nora (CSM): Renewal signal: usage up, but margin pressure from latency. Customer mentioned they'd like a region failover test next month. Also asked about HSM-backed keys for PHI workloads.

ops-bot: deploy:coraledge/private/vpc-eu-west-1 rolled back 2024-11-09T03:25:12Z by @Liam due to KMS handshake errors.

Emma Chen: Copy. Raj — can you paste the specific KMS error trace for eu-west so we can share with CoralEdge? Also confirm if HSM option is available in prod.

Raj Patel: KMS trace snippet:
```
ERROR 2024-11-09T03:25:10Z kms_client: handshake failed, status=504, body="timeout waiting for HSM response"
stack: kms/transport.go:87 -> kms/manager.go:210
```
We escalated to infra; AWS KMS proxy showed increased latency during key rotation window. HSM option: yes, but requires Private deployment + extra config and compliance review.

Sofia Martinez: Customer impact timeline: 03:12–03:28 UTC on Thu. Estimated affected requests ~2.1k, error spike to 4.2% for that window. CS outreach scheduled today.

Liam O'Connor: Mitigations implemented: 1) pinned to old key until rotation completes; 2) increased KMS retry backoff; 3) disabled auto-rotate for this tenant for 48h. Will monitor.

Emma Chen: Actions / owners:
- Raj: follow up with infra + raw KMS logs (ETA EOD)
- Liam: monitor ap-southeast node OOMs + increase swap or tune eviction (ETA 24h)
- Sofia/Nora: schedule failover test with customer (ETA next Tues)
- Emma: prepare cost summary + recommendation for reserved throughput (ETA 48h)

Sofia Martinez: FYI - customer asked about dedicated HSM (FIPS) quote. Nora, can you add to renewal book?

Nora (CSM): Adding now. Also logging CS feedback: wants clearer SLOs around KMS rotation windows and advance notices.

Emma Chen: Thanks all. Post any follow-ups in this thread. :thumbsup:

Raj Patel: will send logs + ticket ref by EOD. :white_check_mark:

Liam O'Connor: monitoring dashboards updated, alerts lowered to avoid noisy pagers overnight.

ops-bot: note: next scheduled key rotation in eu-west-1 for CoralEdge: 2024-11-16T03:00:00Z
